description: Update an existing Auto Scaling Group. minSize and maxSize are always required (pass the current values to keep them — see ncloud_get_asg_detail); other omitted fields keep their current values. Fails while the group is scaling. A new launch configuration applies only to servers created afterwards.

autoScalingGroupNo.description: Auto Scaling Group number to update

desiredCapacity.description: Desired number of servers (between minSize and maxSize)

healthCheckGracePeriod.description: Health check grace period in seconds. Required when healthCheckTypeCode=LOADB.

healthCheckTypeCode.description: Health check type: SVR (server) or LOADB (load balancer — requires healthCheckGracePeriod)

launchConfigurationNo.description: New launch configuration number (applies to servers created after the update)

maxSize.description: Maximum number of servers (0-30, ≥ minSize). Required by the API even when unchanged.

minSize.description: Minimum number of servers (0-30, ≤ maxSize). Required by the API even when unchanged.

serverNamePrefix.description: New server name prefix (3-7 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-')

name: ncloud_update_asg
